title: Mask My File
hero: Share safely without losing useful context. Mask My File finds private details before you send a file, permanently protects them, then reopens and verifies a new output before showing Private Ready.
formatsText:
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Images and PDFs: full-width preview, up to 5× zoom, drag, and precise manual selections.
• Visual files: permanent solid redaction or remove only. Face and barcode detection provides regions for review.
• Text, JSON, XML, HTML, CSV, TSV, and RTF: search every match; use stars for a full mask, partial mask, placeholder, pseudonym, or remove.
• Remove metadata where appropriate. Work page by page in PDFs, or across up to 100 files with individual previews, cross-file search, and per-file manual selections.
• Keep work organised with Private Session, project workspaces, and Placeholder Vault.

supportIntro:
USE IT WHEN IT MATTERS
Before sending a rental application, sharing a medical document, or handing a customer file to a colleague, preserve the useful context while permanently protecting private details.
step1: Choose a file, review detections, apply a supported protection, export it, and reopen the new file to verify it.

contactText: Email hourstag.app@gmail.com with your device model, iOS version, file type, and a short description.
privacyIntro:
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything is processed on your device. There is no account, advertising, tracking, analytics, or content upload. Apple Vision and embedded Tesseract OCR run locally. Face detection creates only regions: it does not identify a person, create a template, share face data, or retain it. Apple handles purchases with StoreKit. Mask My File does not use a VPN, NetworkExtension, proxy, tunnel, DNS filter, or network routing. Originals are never overwritten; temporary workspace files, Private Session data, and projects remain on the device until you delete them.
